marketingText: The Spectrum DM26PBV Petrol Blower-Vac provides and affordable - but high-quality - solution for those seeking a fast, hassle-free way to maintain a neat and tidy garden. The airflow can be adjusted to suit both the type of debris you're trying to shift and the surface you're working on. If you choose to use the Spectrum DM26PBV as a vacuum, you'll not only save even more time, you'll also end-up with a valuable mulch that's ideal for composting, or for spreading over flowerbeds to protect plants from frost damage during the winter months. Collected material is shredded, before being deposited into a large-capacity collection bag. marketingText: Spectrum SBS480CBV - Blow, Vac, Mulch. Garden tidy in minutes. Autumn leaves, post-mow clippings, damp debris in hard-to-reach corners - the Spectrum SBS480CBV Cordless Blower Vac takes care of it all. One tool, three functions: blower, vacuum, and mulcher. No cables. No compromise. In blower mode, the SBS480CBV generates an air speed of up to 52m/s with an air volume of 264m³/h - enough to shift stubborn wet leaves from paths, patios, and lawn edges in quick, efficient passes. Switch to vacuum mode and the air volume jumps to 588m³/h, pulling debris into the 12-litre collection bag while the built-in 3-blade mulching system shreds it at a 30:1 ratio. That means a full bag's worth of leaves compresses down to a fraction of its original volume - fewer trips to the compost heap, more time getting on with the job. Weighing just 4.26kg with an adjustable handle, the SBS480CBV stays comfortable during longer sessions. A reliable brush motor delivers the consistent airflow you need without the noise and exhaust of a petrol equivalent. Tool-only model. Compatible with Spectrum 2.0Ah and 4.0Ah batteries and all Spectrum 40V chargers, all available separately.
